# Stand Tall Realty

> Real estate consultancy in Wanowrie, Pune, India. We help people buy, sell and rent flats, bungalows, shops, offices and plots across Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad. Slogan: "Where Your Dreams Stand Tall".

- Office: Unity Splendour, Salunke Vihar Road, Borade Nagar, Wanowrie, Pune, Maharashtra 411040
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 99200 79048
- Hours: open all 7 days, 10 am to 7:30 pm
- Website: https://www.standtallrealty.com
- Instagram: @standtallrealty

## The Stand Tall Promise
- Listings marked "Stand Tall Verified" were visited and checked by our team; the badge shows the date and drops off after 30 days.
- Fees are agreed in writing before the first site visit. On new projects the builder pays our fee.
- We never sell anyone's number.
- A real person replies within 15 minutes, 10 am to 7:30 pm, every day.
